description: Add, remove, or list watches. Watch a company's SEC filings (target = ticker/name/CIK, optional formType like 8-K) or any URL (target = https://…, watched by content hash). Adding baselines current state; use watch_check later to see only what's new.

formType.description: Optional form filter for filings watches, e.g. "8-K"

target.description: Ticker/name/CIK, URL, or watch id (for remove)

name: watch_manage
title: Manage Watches (change-detection)
